name: Attribute Table Join
definition: Joins fields from a non-spatial or spatial table to features using a shared key without applying a spatial predicate.

name: Check Geometry
definition: Checks feature geometry for validity and identifies errors.

name: Repair Geometry
definition: Repairs invalid feature geometries automatically.

name: Delete Identical
definition: Deletes duplicate feature records based on geometry and/or attributes.

name: Add Spatial Index
definition: Adds a spatial index to a feature class to improve spatial query performance.

name: Rasterize Vector
definition: Converts vector geometries and selected attributes into raster cells on a defined grid.

name: Polygonize Raster
definition: Converts contiguous raster regions into vector polygon features while preserving raster values as attributes.

name: Project/Reproject
definition: Transforms spatial data from one coordinate reference system (CRS) to another including projection and datum transformation.

name: Define Projection
definition: Defines or updates the coordinate system metadata for a dataset without transforming coordinate values.

name: Vector Grid Generation
definition: Creates a vector fishnet, rectangular, diamond, hexagonal, or regular-point grid over an extent.

name: Simplify
definition: Reduces the complexity of feature geometries by removing vertices while preserving essential shape using tolerance.

name: Smooth
definition: Smooths sharp angles in feature geometries by fitting curves or adding vertices.

name: Delete Holes
definition: Removes interior polygon rings below a threshold or removes all holes from polygon geometries.

name: Concave Hull
definition: Creates a concave enclosing polygon that follows the shape of input features more closely than a convex hull.

name: Extract Vertices
definition: Creates point features for all or selected vertices of input geometries, preserving source and vertex indices.

name: Feature to Polygon
definition: Converts line features that form closed loops into polygon features.

name: Polygon to Line
definition: Converts polygon boundaries to line features.

name: Create Thiessen Polygons
definition: Creates Thiessen (Voronoi) polygons around point features dividing space based on proximity.

name: Snap
definition: Moves vertices or features to coincide with vertices/edges/endpoints of reference features within specified distance.

name: Delaunay Triangulation
definition: Performs Delaunay triangulation on point features to create triangle mesh satisfying Delaunay criterion.
